label: One world is possible relative to another iff every shared individual has near origins in them
paraphrase: Rival framework commitment, unattributed (analyst reconstruction of the origin-tolerance account; attribution deferred): for all worlds w and v, v is accessible from w exactly when every individual existing at both w and v has near origins at w and at v. The only-if half is origin essentialism with tolerance (no accessible world gives an existing individual a far origin); the if half says origin closeness is the only constraint on access. Identity across worlds is rigid identity of the individual carrier; no counterpart relation.
